Class StaticJournalsRepository

java.lang.Object
lms.persistence.StaticJournalsRepository
All Implemented Interfaces:
JournalsRepository
public class StaticJournalsRepository extends Object implements JournalsRepository
In-memory implementation of JournalsRepository using a static HashMap.

Stores journals in a map with support for CRUD operations and search by title or author. Pre-loaded with sample journal data. This implementation is not thread-safe and intended for testing purposes.

Version:
2.0
Author:
Ahmad Salameh
